evidence_items.explanation: The analysis supports substantial continuing financing needs and describes increasing use of debt. It also describes earlier retained-earnings funding, and its outlook does not establish that every project requires perpetual borrowing or that credit access was broadly deteriorating.
This is contemporaneous evidence of reported financing friction in a specific project, accompanied by an explicit company denial. It cannot establish an undisputed industry-wide deterioration.

Oracle announced a financing plan combining equity and debt, with a bounded bond issuance. This limits a literal or debt-only reading of ‘endless’; an announced plan does not prove successful execution or easy credit access.
